company.name: PlanetScale
company.shortDescription: A fully managed database platform for Vitess/MySQL & Postgres—NVMe-backed performance, horizontal sharding, & enterprise-grade reliability
company.description:
PlanetScale is a fully managed database platform for Vitess/MySQL and Postgres, delivering NVMe-backed performance, massive scale through horizontal sharding, and enterprise-grade reliability.

Our serverless database platform is built on the tested scalability of Vitess. With predictable scale, workflow velocity, and the ability to deploy features without downtime, we empower development teams to do more with their time. 

PlanetScale created Vitess, a MySQL sharding solution powering products such as YouTube, Slack, Square and many more. PlanetScale’s expertise helps such businesses scale their new and existing infrastructure faster.

aiResearchSummary.text: PlanetScale is advancing database technology by developing a caching layer that resolves data races and deduplicates rows between upqueries and updates, enhancing SQL query performance with write order consistency. Additionally, they are innovating in database management by enabling schema branching workflows, allowing users to create and edit branches of a main database schema, and merge changes back efficiently. These efforts focus on improving database performance and flexibility, aligning with their core offering of a database-as-a-service built on Vitess.
